sections.h2: Reported rural wage growth jumped to 18.12% when the sample changed

sections.means: Reported all-occupation wage growth rose after the Bureau changed its sample, while the break-adjusted estimate is far lower.
sections.todo: Publish an official back-series on the old sample so wage growth can be compared like for like.

sections.todo: Publish an official back-series that weights regions by population so the average is not driven by sample design.
